invariants.rationale: Since map is required for processing and passed to sub-methods, it is likely non-null at method exit.
tile is dereferenced for getObjects() and getTextureRegion(); thus, must be non-null.
element is an argument and passed forward; being null would likely trigger an exception.
Method uses tile.getTextureRegion().getRegionHeight(); so getTextureRegion() must be non-null.
tile.getObjects() is used as an argument and must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
